Clean package caches and package lists.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

<dl class="reference-list">

<dt>

`autoremove`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `false`

With APT, remove automatically installed packages that are no longer required.
Ignored on Alpine.

</dd>

</dl>

## Scheduling

<dl class="reference-list">

<dt>

Priority

</dt>
<dd>

`-900000`

</dd>

<dt>

Dependencies

</dt>
<dd>

None

</dd>

</dl>

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Runs late so other recipes can install packages first. On APT-based systems, set
autoremove when the final filesystem should also drop packages no longer
required by installed packages. Alpine ignores this option.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/pkg-cleanup"]
```
